summary: The team agreed to move the Q4 launch to December 15 so Finance has an extra week to close the budget. The board pre-read is complete. The revised launch plan remains blocked on vendor estimates, and the scanner pilot shortlist is in progress. A possible hiring freeze was raised but not decided; it moves to next week's agenda.

decisions.rationale: Finance needs an extra week to close the budget.
